moments.title: Premier League 2026/27 Kicks Off!
moments.blurb: The 2026/27 Premier League season begins today, Friday, August 21st, with reigning champions Arsenal hosting newly promoted Coventry City, followed by a packed weekend of fixtures.

angles.name: Opening Day Excitement
angles.copy: The Premier League is BACK! Arsenal kick off the new season tonight against Coventry City. Who are you backing for the title this year?

angles.name: Weekend Fixtures Preview
angles.copy: It's the opening weekend of the Premier League! Get ready for Hull City vs Man Utd, Newcastle vs Liverpool, and more. What's your top match to watch?

moments.title: England Crushes Pakistan in First Test
moments.blurb: England secured a dominant innings victory over Pakistan in the first Test at Headingley today, winning by an innings and 103 runs.

angles.name: Test Match Victory
angles.copy: Clinical! England have delivered a crushing innings victory against Pakistan in the first Test. What a performance! #EnglandCricket

moments.title: Back to School for Scotland
moments.blurb: Many schools across Scotland are returning today, August 21st, as the autumn term begins, while pupils in England, Wales, and Northern Ireland prepare to return in early September.

angles.name: Scottish Schools Return
angles.copy: It's back to school for many across Scotland today! Hope everyone has a great first day back and a smooth start to the new academic year. #BackToSchoolScotland

moments.title: All Points East Festival Kicks Off
moments.blurb: The All Points East festival in London's Victoria Park begins today, August 21st, running through to August 30th, featuring major artists like The Weeknd and Ariana Grande.

angles.name: Festival Opening Day
angles.copy: All Points East is officially underway in Victoria Park! Who are you excited to catch this weekend? Let us know!

angles.name: Big Names at APE
angles.copy: The Weeknd and Ariana Grande are among the huge names hitting All Points East! London is buzzing with festival vibes. #AllPointsEast

moments.title: Rewind Festival South Brings 80s Magic
moments.blurb: Rewind Festival South, celebrating 80s music, takes place this weekend, August 21st-23rd, in Henley-On-Thames.

angles.name: 80s Festival Weekend
angles.copy: Dust off your leg warmers! Rewind Festival South is bringing all the 80s hits to Henley-On-Thames this weekend. What's your favourite 80s anthem?

moments.title: Reading & Leeds Festivals Next Week
moments.blurb: Anticipation builds for Reading & Leeds Festivals, set for August 28th-30th, featuring headliners like Charli XCX, Chase & Status, Dave, Florence + The Machine, Fontaines D.C. and RAYE.

angles.name: One Week To Go
angles.copy: Only one week until Reading & Leeds Festivals! Who are you most excited to see? The lineup is huge this year!

angles.name: Headliner Hype
angles.copy: Charli XCX, Dave, RAYE, Florence + The Machine... Reading & Leeds is going to be epic! Which headliner has you most hyped?

moments.title: Between The Trees Festival in Bridgend
moments.blurb: Between The Trees Festival, a nature-inspired music and arts event, takes place in Candleston Wood, Bridgend, from August 27th-30th.

angles.name: Local Welsh Festival
angles.copy: Get ready for Between The Trees Festival! Bridgend's own nature-inspired music and arts event kicks off next Thursday. Who's heading to Candleston Wood?

angles.name: Festival Focus
angles.copy: Between The Trees Festival is almost here! Celebrating music, arts, and nature in Bridgend from Aug 27-30. Perfect for a late summer escape. #WelshFestivals

moments.title: Beautiful Days Festival in Devon

angles.name: Devon Festival Fun
